AlarmDescription: Alert 3 of 6. For 5 consecutive minutes the API's readiness database check has failed (dari.database.reachable = 0: database down, or no pool connection within 5 s), or the API published no metrics at all. Silence counts as breaching on purpose: alerts 3-5 depend on the metrics push, and this is its dead-man's switch. If alert 1 is also firing, start there. Runbook: docs/PRODUCTION_OPERATIONS.md, Monitoring > First response > Database unreachable.
